verdict.rationale: Extend's Extract API takes a schema with custom field types such as date, currency and signature, passed via a config object. Each run returns "the values your schema defined, plus per-field confidence scores and citations" pointing back to the source page. A year-long customer independently praises its extraction accuracy. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the schema is standard JSON Schema, documentation of output validation or type enforcement against the schema, and hands-on corroboration of schema-conformant output.
